mods.name: Lipi
mods.description: A lightweight, independent chat system that runs alongside vanilla Minecraft chat. Lipi is a server-controlled communication tool. Chat logs are stored locally on the server machine. Server operators are solely responsible for moderation, log storage, retention, and compliance with applicable laws in their jurisdiction.

releases.notes:
## Lipi v3.0.0-alpha

### What's new in V3

#### Dedicated Lipi chat window
Messages now display in a proper Lipi chat screen — 
completely separate from vanilla chat. Vanilla chat 
is unaffected and unchanged.

#### New UI
- Popup chat window with sidebar showing # general channel
- Username in bold with local time timestamp (HH:MM) 
  per message
- Scrollable message history
- Auto-scroll to latest message, pauses when scrolling up
- No background blur — world stays visible while chatting

#### Input improvements
- Right Shift opens Lipi chat and immediately focuses 
  the input — no extra click needed
- Command suggestions when typing / (same as vanilla chat)
- ESC to close

#### HUD indicator
- Persistent L indicator on screen during gameplay
- Unread message badge shows count when messages arrive 
  while chat is closed
- Badge clears when you scroll to bottom of messages

#### Security fixes
- Server now derives player identity server-side
- Client no longer sends UUID or username — server 
  pulls these from the connection directly
- Timestamps generated server-side

#### Admin kit
- `/lipi mute <player> <duration>` — temp mute with 
  10s, 5m, 1h, 1d format
- `/lipi mutelist` — lists muted players with expiry
- Message length limit config (`max-message-length`)
- Per-player cooldown config (`message-cooldown-seconds`)
- Global slow mode config (`slow-mode-seconds`)
- Auto-unmute when temp mute expires

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.5
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Must be installed on BOTH client and server

### Known limitations
- 1.21.5 only — backports planned
- One channel (general) — multi-channel coming in Beta V1

### What's coming in Beta V1
- Multi-channel support
- Media and GIF sharing
- Improved moderation tools
- 1.21.1 backport

releases.notes:
## Lipi v2.0.0-alpha

### What's new
- Dedicated Lipi chat screen — Right Shift now opens 
  Lipi's own screen instead of intercepting vanilla chat
- ESC to close the Lipi screen
- Vanilla chat (T key) is completely separate and 
  unaffected
- Minecraft commands can be run directly from the 
  Lipi screen
- Cleaner architecture — Lipi no longer depends on 
  vanilla ChatScreen at all

### Known issues in this release
- Messages currently render in vanilla chat instead of 
  a dedicated display window — fix coming in Alpha V3
- Chat history on join shows raw UUIDs — being cleaned 
  up in Alpha V3
- Timestamps show server time not player local time

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.5
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Must be installed on BOTH client and server

### What's coming in Alpha V3
- Dedicated Lipi message display window
- Timestamp format fix (HH:MM only)
- UUID cleanup in chat history

releases.notes:
## Lipi v1.0.0-alpha

First public alpha release of Lipi — an independent, 
server-controlled chat channel for Fabric servers running 
alongside vanilla Minecraft chat.

### What's included
- Right Shift to toggle Lipi mode on/off
- `[Lipi]` indicator when active
- Global Lipi chat channel
- `/w <player> <message>` whisper
- Chat history on join (last 20 messages)
- Adjustable chat background opacity
- Server-side logging with configurable retention
- Admin commands: `/lipi mute`, `/lipi unmute`, 
  `/lipi toggle`, `/lipi log <player>`
- Graceful fallback if server doesn't have the mod

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.5
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

### Notes
This is an alpha release — core features are working but 
the mod has not been tested across all server configurations. 
Report bugs via GitHub Issues.

Alpha V2 is already in development with a dedicated Lipi 
chat screen replacing the vanilla chat dependency.
